title: Required content should follow the profile's reference shape: conceptId#anchor requires that section, a bare conceptId the whole document (DEC-194 (5))
description:
DEC-194 (5) follow-up (opum-ai/opum-doc#1030), sequenced AFTER LCLI-722's cap PR (opum-ai/lore-cli#592). Deliberately NOT changed in that PR, on the leader's ruling.

WHAT IS WRONG TODAY. In the evidence tier, required content is matched by `conceptId` ALONE — the `ordered.filter((candidate) => candidate.conceptId === constitutionId)` set in `src/core/agent-context.ts`. EVERY candidate of that concept is therefore required, so a profile that RANKS the bundle's Constitution requires the WHOLE document, every section of it. That is not intended as a default: under DEC-194 (1)'s "pin sections, not documents", required content should mean what the profile PINS — a bare `conceptId` pins the whole document, and `conceptId#anchor` pins that section alone.

WHY IT MATTERS. Both reservations that landed with LCLI-722 — against the `task_evidence` cap and against the pack's `max_tokens` — size required content from that set. A profile that ranks the Constitution but wants one section of it therefore reserves, and can fail for, the whole document. The reservations are correct; the SET they reserve for is too wide. A whole Constitution is also what makes `CONTEXT_REQUIRED_CONTENT_OVER_BUDGET` reachable at a small `max_tokens`, when a single anchored section would have fitted.

WHAT TO DO. Make required content follow the profile's own reference shape. A `pinned`/`sources` entry that is a bare concept id keeps exactly the whole-document semantics it has today; an entry carrying `#anchor` requires THAT SECTION only. The required set then holds the anchored candidates, and `requiredTokens` sizes what the profile actually asked for rather than the whole document.

PROVE BOTH WAYS. A profile ranking `constitution#<section>` reserves and keeps only that section, while a profile ranking the bare `constitution` still reserves the whole document (the present behaviour, pinned so the change does not silently widen or narrow it). And a profile whose ANCHORED required section fits compiles, where the whole document would not. MUTATION CONTROL: widen the required set back to the bare `conceptId` and confirm the anchored-fits case goes red.

SEQUENCING AND THE STANDING CHECK. After LCLI-722's cap PR lands. If any of the four real profiles throws because a whole Constitution is required, THAT is this task's fix and not a raised budget — reported at filing as NOT currently the case: all four real profiles compile (documentation, implementation, review, verification), measured after the DEC-194 (5) reservations landed, so this task is a correctness-of-semantics change rather than a gate that is red today.
